core_obligations: Identify b^{-1}(U) with the Proj of the Rees algebra from the glueing construction (proof lines 8336-8338).
Show the degree-one elements generate the Rees algebra and hence cover the Proj by the D_+(a^{(1)}) (proof lines 8338-8342).
Identify each D_+(a^{(1)}) with the spectrum of an affine blowup algebra (proof lines 8342-8347).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent ideal I on X, an affine open U = Spec(A) with ideal I, and the blowup b : X' -> X in I, there is a canonical isomorphism of b^{-1}(U) with Proj of the Rees algebra of I in A, and b^{-1}(U) is covered by the affine spectra of the affine blowup algebras A[I/a] (source lines 8321-8334). The proof reads the first statement off the glueing construction of the relative Proj, and then shows that the degree-one elements a^{(1)} generate the Rees algebra, so that the Proj is covered by the affine opens D_+(a^{(1)}) which are the spectra of the affine blowup algebras.
